name: 3d-engineering
description: >-
  Engineer parametric mechanical parts and assemblies with the CAD3D platform. Use
  for product design, enclosures, supports, mechanisms, interfaces, fluid paths,
  build123d/OCP, STEP/STL, FDM/DFAM, and OrcaSlicer workflows. Do not use for

# CAD3D product engineering

Use the existing global `cad3d` CLI; it runs the CAD engine (`build123d`/OCP) and,
optionally, the isolated OrcaSlicer manufacturing engine. Do not install CAD Python
packages on the host. Start with `cad3d --help` and `cad3d doctor` when needed.

## Workflow

For consequential products, proceed in gates: requirements → functional architecture
→ mechanical architecture → parametric geometry → system review → manufacturing.
Use `cad3d architecture init --level product` and edit `.cad3d/engineering.yaml`;
validate with `cad3d architecture validate`. Do not create functional solids before
the first three gates pass. Simple spacers/supports may use the lightweight project
level; match process depth to risk.

Model from explicit datums, units, interfaces and parameters. Map each component to a
function, positioning relation and retention method; explicitly declare intended free
parts. Validate geometry and assemblies using `cad3d build`, then run
`cad3d architecture validate --geometry`, `cad3d review`, and
`cad3d report --requirements`. Correct FAIL results and rerun the relevant checks.
PASS requires traceable evidence; declaration or a generated solid alone is not proof.
Treat WARNING and NOT_EVALUATED as unresolved review items. A CAD-valid assembly is
not thereby mechanically stable, printable, physically validated, or ready to release.

Generate technical views with `cad3d render --view engineering`: opaque isometric,
orthographic top/front/side, section, exploded, plus configured hidden-component and
critical-interface views. Review the actual images for occlusion and legibility.
Export with `cad3d export`. For FDM use the versioned printer/material/process
profiles and `cad3d slice --printer elegoo-cc2 --material petg`; inspect
`cad3d slice-report`. Slicing is an estimate, not printer compatibility or physical
validation. Never start a print or transmit a file to a printer.

## Load references by project class

- General product phases and gates: [product_engineering.md](references/product_engineering.md)
- Requirements, YAML contract, interfaces and evidence: [requirements_and_interfaces.md](references/requirements_and_interfaces.md)
- Assemblies, retention, fit and service: [mechanical_assemblies.md](references/mechanical_assemblies.md)
- FDM design and profiles: [dfam.md](references/dfam.md)
- Passive channels and fluid paths: [fluid_systems.md](references/fluid_systems.md)
- Adversarial/system review: [design_review.md](references/design_review.md)
- Professional view generation: [visual_validation.md](references/visual_validation.md)
- Commercial part envelopes: [commercial_components.md](references/commercial_components.md)
- Existing CAD checks: [assembly-validation.md](references/assembly-validation.md)
- OrcaSlicer engine and its limits: [orcaslicer-engine.md](references/orcaslicer-engine.md)

Choose relevant references; do not load every topic for a simple part. Keep requirement
implementation distinct from verification, engineering judgment distinct from automated
checks, and physical validation distinct from CAD/slicer evidence. For adversarial review,
use a fresh Codex context when available. A sequential checklist is not an independent
review; report that limitation explicitly.

# Mechanical assemblies

Each component has stable ID, function and positioned geometry. Each movable or removable component needs a relation and retention method, or an explicit reason for intentional freedom. Placement only proves location. Distinguish contact, clearance and positive-volume interference. Declared contact does not authorize volume overlap.

Describe interfaces with mating regions/faces, datums, insertion axis, fit/tolerance profile, and intended service operation. Check collision and clearance, then test sampled linear assembly/removal trajectories where supported. Sampling cannot prove continuous collision-free motion or load capacity. For screws, snaps, captured rails and pressure fits, review actual load path, access, deformation and release strategy. Record assembly steps and evidence; unresolved force, fatigue and print anisotropy remain warnings or not evaluated.
# FDM and DFAM

Use declared printer, nozzle, material and process profiles. Treat uncalibrated values as starting estimates, never universal tolerances. Check per-axis build envelope for candidate orientations, wall features, disconnected bodies, overhang/support heuristics, interface orientation relative to layers and slicer estimates. These are assessments, not print guarantees. Choose orientation with explicit tradeoffs; fastest is not necessarily strongest.

Use calibration specimens for clearance, pins/holes, walls, sliding fits, bridges and overhangs. Record measured results against exact printer/nozzle/material/process profile revision. Do not silently propagate a calibration to old project contracts. After printing, record dimensions and physical fit results separately.

# Product engineering workflow

Scale rigor to consequence. For a simple noncritical part, document its function, dimensions, printer envelope and fit assumptions; for assemblies and flow systems use all phase gates. A product contract lives at `.cad3d/engineering.yaml` and is validated by `cad3d architecture validate`.

1. Requirements: function, operating conditions, verified measurements vs assumptions, commercial items, acceptance, external interfaces, risks and unknowns.
2. Functional architecture: subsystems, input/output, physical flows, modes and failure modes. Demonstrate conceptual operation without CAD.
3. Mechanical architecture: datums, constraints, attachment/retention, fits, service access, disassembly sequence and print splits.
4. Modeling: only after phases 1–3 validate; parametric parts, placed assembly, interfaces and early views.
5. System review: requirements evidence, interfaces, retention, assembly/removal, access, channels, manufacturing and residual risks.
6. Fabrication: orient and assess, optional OrcaSlicer, export, prototype plan and dimensional inspection.

Critical FAIL or required NOT_EVALUATED blocks subsequent approval. Warnings need disposition. CAD B-rep validity, assembly validity, manufacturing assessment, slicing success, printer compatibility and physical validation are separate claims.
# Requirements and interfaces

Edit the extensible YAML contract at `.cad3d/engineering.yaml`; see `templates/engineering.yaml`. Stable IDs connect requirements, subsystems, components, interfaces, dependencies, verification method, evidence and status. Evidence uses a project-relative JSON file and JSON Pointer; the validator reads it and fingerprints its value. A claimed implementation is not verification. PASS needs current, identifiable evidence; unknown evidence is NOT_EVALUATED.

Record measurement provenance and label every dimension `verified` or `assumption`. Never silently promote assumptions. Interfaces state participants, reference geometry, datum, intended relation, fit class and selected printer/material/calibration tolerance. Report unavailable geometry checks as NOT_EVALUATED. Use physical validation status separately.

# Critical design review

Run `cad3d build`, geometry architecture checks and `cad3d review`; inspect the generated findings, evidence, severity, impact, correction and required verification. Challenge: function assigned to every part; support/retention for every installed part; complete interfaces; assembly and maintenance access; service path; commercial-part removal; dimensions derived from assumptions; fit tolerance source; physical route continuity; unsupported claims; residual risks; and stale or absent evidence.

Critical findings block approval. Do not turn checklist completion into PASS. Separate checks a program executes from engineering judgment. The built-in review is sequential and shares project evidence with the author; it is not independent. Where supported, conduct a fresh-context adversarial review and preserve its findings. Explicitly list unanswered questions and physical validation still needed.
# Visual validation

Use the CAD engine's PyVista/VTK renderer, which tessellates the live build123d/OCP shapes for images without changing the authoritative B-rep. `cad3d render --view engineering` produces common-coordinate opaque isometric, top/front/side orthographic, 2D tessellated section intersection outlines (without synthetic caps), exploded views and configured hidden-component/critical-interface images. Check `engineering-views.json`; optional views without configured targets are not evaluated.

Use section views to reveal internal geometry instead of indiscriminate transparency. Confirm orientation, component colors, legend, crop and occlusion in the actual PNGs. Exploded offsets explain separation only; they are not assembly trajectories. Image agreement does not establish geometric validity. Camera/view evidence should be tied to the source model/assembly revision.

"""Caixa de calibração genérica, com corpo e tampa separados."""
from build123d import Align, Box, Locations, Mode, Pos


def build(params):
    p = params["box"]
    length, width, height = p["length"], p["width"], p["height"]
    wall, gap = p["wall"], p["clearance"]
    if min(length, width, height, wall) <= 0 or gap < 0:
        raise ValueError("Dimensões e parede precisam ser positivas; folga não pode ser negativa")
    if 2 * wall >= min(length, width) or wall >= height:
        raise ValueError("Parede incompatível com dimensões externas")
    body_outer = Box(length, width, height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    cavity = Pos(0, 0, wall) * Box(length-2*wall, width-2*wall, height,
                                    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    body = body_outer - cavity
    lid_h = max(2.0, wall)
    lid = Pos(0, 0, height + 5) * Box(length+2*gap, width+2*gap, lid_h,
                                      align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    return {"body": body, "lid": lid}

def validate_architecture(project_root: Path, *, shapes=None, placed_shapes=None):
    """Validate `.cad3d/engineering.yaml` structure and CAD-linked evidence."""
    root = Path(project_root).resolve()
    contract_path = root / ".cad3d/engineering.yaml"
    if not contract_path.is_file():
        return {"status": "NOT_EVALUATED", "reason": "engineering_contract_missing",
                "contract": str(contract_path), "phases": {}, "checks": []}
    contract = _read_yaml(contract_path)
    eng = contract.get("engineering", {})
    project = eng.get("project", {})
    level = eng.get("workflow_level", "product")
    checks = []
    expected_project = ("name", "class", "purpose", "units")
    missing = [field for field in expected_project if not project.get(field) or
               str(project.get(field)).strip().lower() in ("todo", "tbd", "unknown")]
    _check(checks, "project-identity", "Identidade e propósito do produto",
           "FAIL" if missing else "PASS", detail={"missing": missing}, severity="critical",
           recommendation="Defina nome, classe, função do produto e unidades explícitas.")

    reqs = eng.get("requirements", []) or []
    subsystems = (eng.get("functional_architecture", {}) or {}).get("subsystems", []) or []
    components = (eng.get("mechanical_architecture", {}) or {}).get("components", []) or []
    interfaces = (eng.get("mechanical_architecture", {}) or {}).get("interfaces", []) or []
    req_ids = _unique(reqs, "id", "requirements", checks)
    subsystem_ids = _unique(subsystems, "id", "subsystems", checks)
    component_ids = _unique(components, "id", "components", checks)
    interface_ids = _unique(interfaces, "id", "interfaces", checks)
    assembly_path = root / ".cad3d/assembly.yaml"
    assembly = _read_yaml(assembly_path) if assembly_path.is_file() else {}
    assembly_components = {str(item.get("id")): item for item in assembly.get("components", [])}
    assembly_pairs = {frozenset((str(item.get("a")), str(item.get("b")))): item
                      for item in assembly.get("interfaces", [])}

    phase_checks = {"requirements": [], "functional_architecture": [], "mechanical_architecture": [],
                    "modeling": [], "system_verification": [], "manufacturing": []}
    for field in ("operating_conditions", "measurements", "external_interfaces",
                  "acceptance_criteria", "risks_and_unknowns"):
        value = eng.get(field, [])
        minimum = 1 if level == "product" else (0 if field in ("operating_conditions", "risks_and_unknowns") else 1)
        ok = bool(value) and isinstance(value, list) if minimum else isinstance(value, list)
        _check(phase_checks["requirements"], f"requirements-{field}", field.replace("_", " ").title(),
               "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", detail={"item_count": len(value) if isinstance(value, list) else 0},
               severity="critical", recommendation=f"Registre {field.replace('_', ' ')} antes de fechar a arquitetura.")
    measurements = eng.get("measurements", []) or []
    unclassified_measurements = [m.get("id", "<missing-id>") for m in measurements
        if m.get("confidence") not in ("verified", "assumption") or
        (m.get("confidence") == "verified" and not m.get("source")) or
        (m.get("confidence") == "assumption" and not m.get("uncertainty"))]
    _check(phase_checks["requirements"], "measurement-evidence", "Medições separadas de hipóteses",
           "FAIL" if unclassified_measurements else ("PASS" if measurements else "NOT_EVALUATED"),
           detail={"unclassified": unclassified_measurements}, severity="critical",
           recommendation="Classifique cada medida como verified com source, ou assumption com uncertainty.")
    empty_criteria = [x.get("id", "<missing-id>") for x in eng.get("acceptance_criteria", []) or []
                      if not x.get("method") or not x.get("threshold")]
    _check(phase_checks["requirements"], "acceptance-criteria-defined", "Critérios de aceitação mensuráveis",
           "FAIL" if empty_criteria else ("PASS" if eng.get("acceptance_criteria") else "NOT_EVALUATED"),
           detail={"incomplete": empty_criteria}, severity="critical",
           recommendation="Defina método de verificação e limiar observável para cada critério.")
    _check(checks, "requirements-phase", "Fase 1: requisitos", _status(phase_checks["requirements"]),
           detail=phase_checks["requirements"], severity="critical")

    min_subsystems = 1 if level == "lightweight" else 2
    _check(phase_checks["functional_architecture"], "functional-subsystems", "Subsistemas com função",
           "WARNING" if len(subsystems) >= min_subsystems and all(x.get("purpose") for x in subsystems) else "FAIL",
           detail={"count": len(subsystems), "minimum": min_subsystems}, severity="critical",
           kind="engineering_judgment",
           recommendation="Revise se as funções declaradas cobrem conceitualmente a operação; presença de campos não comprova funcionamento.")
    flows = (eng.get("functional_architecture", {}) or {}).get("flows", []) or []
    flow_ids = _unique(flows, "id", "flows", phase_checks["functional_architecture"])
    for flow in flows:
        route = flow.get("path", [])
        known_nodes = subsystem_ids | component_ids
        unknown = [str(node) for node in route if str(node) not in known_nodes]
        status = "WARNING" if len(route) >= 2 and not unknown else "FAIL"
        _check(phase_checks["functional_architecture"], f"flow-{flow.get('id')}",
               f"Fluxo funcional {flow.get('id')}", status,
               detail={"path": route, "unknown_nodes": unknown,
                       "evidence_limit": "declared topology only; conceptual operation needs engineering review"},
               severity="critical", kind="engineering_judgment",
               recommendation="Verifique se portas, estados e transições formam uma sequência funcional real.")
    fa = eng.get("functional_architecture", {}) or {}
    for key in ("operating_modes", "failure_modes"):
        ok = bool(fa.get(key))
        _check(phase_checks["functional_architecture"], f"functional-{key}", key.replace("_", " ").title(),
               ("WARNING" if ok else "FAIL"), detail={"item_count": len(fa.get(key, []) or []),
               "evidence_limit": "declared cases require engineering review"},
               severity="critical", kind="engineering_judgment",
               recommendation=f"Revise a cobertura e plausibilidade de {key.replace('_', ' ')}; a lista não comprova comportamento.")
    _check(checks, "functional-architecture-phase", "Fase 2: arquitetura funcional",
           _status(phase_checks["functional_architecture"]), detail=phase_checks["functional_architecture"], severity="critical")

    if not assembly_components and components:
        _check(phase_checks["mechanical_architecture"], "assembly-manifest", "Instâncias CAD de montagem",
               "FAIL", severity="critical", recommendation="Declare as instâncias posicionadas em .cad3d/assembly.yaml.")
    for comp in components:
        ident = str(comp.get("id"))
        retention = comp.get("retention") or {}
        method = retention.get("method")
        evidence = {"assembly_component": assembly_components.get(ident),
                    "part": comp.get("part"), "function": comp.get("function"),
                    "retention": retention}
        if ident not in assembly_components:
            st = "FAIL"; reason = "component_not_present_in_cad_assembly"
        elif not comp.get("part") or not comp.get("function"):
            st = "FAIL"; reason = "part_or_function_missing"
        elif not method:
            st = "FAIL"; reason = "retention_method_missing"
        elif method not in RETENTION_METHODS:
            st = "FAIL"; reason = "unknown_retention_method"
        elif method == "intentional_free":
            st = "PASS" if retention.get("reason") else "FAIL"
            reason = "intentional_free_documented" if st == "PASS" else "intentional_free_requires_reason"
        elif method == "monolithic":
            solid_count = len((shapes or {}).get(comp.get("part"), []).solids()) if shapes and comp.get("part") in shapes else None
            st = "PASS" if solid_count == 1 else ("WARNING" if solid_count is None else "FAIL")
            reason = "single_connected_brep" if st == "PASS" else ("single-body verification deferred until CAD build" if st == "WARNING" else "monolithic_solid_not_proven")
        elif method == "fixed_to_datum":
            st = "WARNING" if retention.get("datum") and retention.get("fastener_interface") else "FAIL"
            reason = "external_fixing_interface_declared_but_load_not_analyzed" if st == "WARNING" else "datum_or_fixing_interface_missing"
        else:
            referenced = retention.get("interface_ids", []) or []
            missing_refs = [x for x in referenced if x not in interface_ids]
            connected = [i for i in interfaces if i.get("id") in referenced and ident in (i.get("components") or [])]
            pair_refs = [i for i in connected if len(i.get("components", [])) == 2 and
                         frozenset(map(str, i["components"])) in assembly_pairs]
            if not referenced or missing_refs or not connected or len(pair_refs) != len(connected):
                st = "FAIL"; reason = "retention_has_no_complete_positioned_interface"
            else:
                st = "WARNING"; reason = "retention_geometry_declared; load_or_capture_strength_not_proven"
        _check(phase_checks["mechanical_architecture"], f"retention-{ident}",
               f"Retenção de {ident}", st, evidence={"component": evidence, "reason": reason},
               severity="critical" if st == "FAIL" else "major",
               recommendation="Declare o método e relacione interfaces CAD posicionadas; valide força/retensão com método apropriado.")

    for interface in interfaces:
        iid = str(interface.get("id")); ends = list(map(str, interface.get("components", [])))
        unknown = [x for x in ends if x not in component_ids or x not in assembly_components]
        cad_pair = frozenset(ends) in assembly_pairs if len(ends) == 2 else False
        has_tolerance = interface.get("tolerance_mm") is not None or interface.get("tolerance_profile") is not None
        has_datum = bool(interface.get("positioning") or interface.get("datums"))
        st = "PASS" if len(ends) == 2 and not unknown and cad_pair and interface.get("kind") and has_tolerance and has_datum else "FAIL"
        _check(phase_checks["mechanical_architecture"], f"interface-{iid}",
               f"Interface {iid} vinculada ao assembly", st,
               evidence={"components": ends, "cad_pair_found": cad_pair, "unknown_components": unknown,
                         "tolerance_defined": has_tolerance, "positioning_defined": has_datum},
               severity="critical", recommendation="Vincule interface aos componentes e ao assembly; defina datum/posicionamento e tolerância nominal ou perfil.")
    mech = eng.get("mechanical_architecture", {}) or {}
    for field in ("maintenance_access", "assembly_steps", "print_split"):
        value = mech.get(field, [])
        _check(phase_checks["mechanical_architecture"], f"mechanical-{field}", field.replace("_", " ").title(),
               "WARNING" if value else "FAIL",
               detail={"item_count": len(value) if isinstance(value, list) else 1 if value else 0,
                       "evidence_limit": "declaration completeness only; outcome is not physically verified"},
               severity="major", kind="engineering_judgment",
               recommendation=f"Revise a viabilidade real de {field.replace('_', ' ')} e vincule a uma evidência executada.")
    _check(checks, "mechanical-architecture-phase", "Fase 3: arquitetura mecânica",
           _status(phase_checks["mechanical_architecture"]), detail=phase_checks["mechanical_architecture"], severity="critical")

    flow_results = []
    flow_shapes = placed_shapes if placed_shapes is not None else shapes
    if flows and flow_shapes is not None:
        flow_results = validate_flow_paths(flow_shapes, flows)
        for result in flow_results:
            _check(phase_checks["system_verification"], f"flow-geometry-{result['id']}",
                   f"Percurso físico {result['id']}", result["status"], evidence=result,
                   severity="critical" if result["status"] == "FAIL" else "major",
                   recommendation="Corrija a obstrução da rota declarada ou marque o caminho como não avaliado.")
    elif flows:
        for item in flows:
            _check(phase_checks["system_verification"], f"flow-geometry-{item.get('id')}",
                   f"Percurso físico {item.get('id')}", "NOT_EVALUATED", severity="critical",
                   recommendation="Execute cad3d architecture validate com a geometria paramétrica carregada.")
    for req in reqs:
        rid = str(req.get("id")); ver = req.get("verification") or {}
        missing_refs = [x for x in req.get("components", []) or [] if x not in component_ids]
        if not req.get("description") or req.get("subsystem") not in subsystem_ids or missing_refs or not ver.get("method"):
            observed = "FAIL"
            ev = {"unknown_components": missing_refs, "subsystem": req.get("subsystem"), "method": ver.get("method")}

engineering:
  schema_version: 1
  workflow_level: product
  model_gate: true
  project:
    name: organizador-modular-de-bancada
    class: FDM printed desktop organizer
    purpose: Store small tools in three removable and reconfigurable categories within a 180 x 120 x 70 mm internal envelope.
    units: mm
  operating_conditions:
    - id: bench_use
      condition: Indoor stationary use on a level workbench; hand insertion and removal of lightweight small tools.
  measurements:
    - id: envelope
      name: Available internal envelope
      value_mm: [180, 120, 70]
      status: verified
      source: User-specified requirement in project request.
    - id: object_sizes
      name: Tool dimensions and quantities by category
      status: assumption
      uncertainty: Unknown; no objects or dimensions supplied. Available module internal space is only a provisional capacity estimate.
  external_interfaces:
    - id: bench_footprint
      description: Flat underside rests on workbench; maximum nominal footprint 180 x 120 mm.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: fit_envelope
      description: All organizer parts remain inside the 180 x 120 x 70 mm envelope.
      method: CAD bounding-box inspection
      threshold: No component extent exceeds the specified internal envelope.
    - id: removable_modules
      description: Three modules can be removed and repositioned by hand without a tool.
      method: CAD interface inspection, then physical fit trial
      threshold: Lift-out/remount motion has no geometric interference; physical force and usability checked on prototype.
    - id: retrieval_access
      description: Contents remain visible and can be grasped from above/front.
      method: Engineering review and physical usability trial
      threshold: Open-top trays with front scoop; all contents reachable by fingers.
  risks_and_unknowns:
    - id: object_envelope_unknown
      description: Tools may not fit the provisional tray clear area or may require tailored dividers.
      mitigation: Measure the largest width, length, height and quantity in each category; adjust parameters and internal layouts before final print.
      status: OPEN
    - id: fit_tolerance
      description: 0.35 mm side clearance is an uncalibrated starting assumption for the selected FDM process.
      mitigation: Print a rail/tray fit coupon and tune clearance using the actual printer, nozzle and material.
      status: OPEN
  requirements:
    - id: REQ-ENV
      description: Fit within the internal envelope 180 x 120 x 70 mm.
      verification: CAD bounding box
      status: implemented
    - id: REQ-CAT
      description: Provide three separately removable modules, one per tool category.
      verification: Component and interface review
      status: implemented
    - id: REQ-ACCESS
      description: Keep contents open and reachable without special tools.
      verification: Geometry and physical usability review
      status: implemented
  functional_architecture:
    subsystems:
      - id: support
        function: Provide a stable low platform and constrain lateral module motion with simple guide rails.
      - id: storage
        function: Hold and segregate three categories in open removable trays.
    flows:
      - id: hand_load
        from: user
        to: modules
        description: Tools are placed or retrieved vertically through the open top and front scoop.
    operating_modes:
      - id: configured
        description: Three modules seated in their guide positions for storage and retrieval.
      - id: reconfigure
        description: Lift a module by its front edge and place it in another position by hand.
    failure_modes:
      - id: tight_fit
        effect: Module binds on rails after printing.
        response: Increase clearance based on fit coupon and reprint affected parts.
      - id: undersized_capacity
        effect: Tools do not fit the provisional internal tray area.
        response: Measure objects and revise the module dimensions or layout before production.
  mechanical_architecture:
    components:
      - id: base
        function: Support organizer and provide guide slots.
        geometry: src/model.py:base
        position: XY centered; bottom at Z=0.
        retention: Gravity and paired low guide rails constrain modules laterally.
      - id: module_1
        function: Removable storage for category 1.
        geometry: src/model.py:module_1
        position: First of three equal-width slots.
        retention: Gravity seated between guide rails; intentional lift-out freedom.
      - id: module_2
        function: Removable storage for category 2.
        geometry: src/model.py:module_2
        position: Middle of three equal-width slots.
        retention: Gravity seated between guide rails; intentional lift-out freedom.
      - id: module_3
        function: Removable storage for category 3.
        geometry: src/model.py:module_3
        position: Third of three equal-width slots.
        retention: Gravity seated between guide rails; intentional lift-out freedom.
    interfaces:
      - id: tray_rail_fit
        participants: [base, module_1, module_2, module_3]
        geometry: Parallel longitudinal guide rails on base and tray exterior sides.
        datum: XY centered footprint, Z=0 underside; tray insertion/removal along +Z.
        relation: Clearance fit, lift-out; no snap or special tool.
        fit_class: Uncalibrated FDM clearance, nominal 0.35 mm per side.
        material_process: Bambu A1 profile, PLA starting profile; calibrate before final fit.
    assembly_steps:
      - step: 1
        action: Place base flat on bench.
      - step: 2
        action: Lower each selected category tray vertically between its pair of guide rails.
      - step: 3
        action: For reconfiguration, lift tray by the accessible front edge and lower into the desired slot.
    maintenance_access:
      - id: contents
        description: Open top exposes all contents; front scoop allows finger access and tray lifting.
      - id: cleaning
        description: Modules lift out vertically without tools for cleaning and rearrangement.
    print_split:
      - id: base_print
        description: Base prints as one flat part, underside on build plate.
      - id: tray_print
        description: Each shallow open tray prints individually, floor on build plate; no supports intended.
  manufacturing:
    physical_validation: NOT_EVALUATED
  visualization:
    hidden_components: [base]
    critical_interfaces: [tray_rail_fit]

"""Three removable, open organizer trays on a shallow common base."""
from build123d import Align, Box, Circle, Cylinder, Mode, Pos


def build(params):
    p = params["organizer"]
    L, W, H = p["length"], p["width"], p["height"]
    wall, floor = p["wall"], p["floor"]
    gap, rail_h, base_h = p["clearance"], p["rail_height"], p["base_height"]
    count = int(p["module_count"])
    usable_w = W - 2 * p["rim"]
    usable_l = L - 2 * p["rim"]
    slot_w = (usable_w - (count - 1) * p["slot_gap"]) / count
    module_w = slot_w - 2 * gap
    module_l = usable_l - 2 * gap
    if min(L, W, H, wall, floor, base_h, module_w, module_l) <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Envelope and feature dimensions must be positive")
    if H < base_h + rail_h + floor + wall:
        raise ValueError("Organizer height cannot contain base, rails and trays")

    # Outer base is the envelope datum: XY centered, Z=0 on the bench.
    base = Box(L, W, base_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    # Low continuous perimeter rim and three pairs of guide rails.
    rim = p["rim"]
    perimeter = Pos(0, 0, base_h) * (Box(L, W, rail_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)) - Pos(0, 0, -0.1) * Box(
        L - 2 * rim, W - 2 * rim, rail_h + 0.2,
        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)))
    rails = None
    for i in range(count):
        x = -usable_w / 2 + slot_w * (i + 0.5)
        pair = Pos(x - module_w / 2 - gap / 2, 0, base_h) * Box(gap, usable_l, rail_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
        pair += Pos(x + module_w / 2 + gap / 2, 0, base_h) * Box(gap, usable_l, rail_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
        rails = pair if rails is None else rails + pair
    base = base + perimeter + rails

    parts = {"base": base}
    for i in range(count):
        x = -usable_w / 2 + slot_w * (i + 0.5)
        z = base_h
        tray = Pos(x, 0, z) * Box(module_w, module_l, p["tray_height"], align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
        cavity = Pos(x, 0, z + floor) * Box(module_w - 2 * wall, module_l - 2 * wall,
                 p["tray_height"] + 0.1, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
        tray = tray - cavity
        # Broad front scoop leaves a visible, finger-accessible retrieval edge.
        notch = Pos(x, -module_l / 2 - 0.01, z + p["tray_height"] + 0.1) * Cylinder(
            p["access_radius"], wall + 0.2, rotation=(90, 0, 0), align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
        tray = tray - notch
        # Each tray is separate and can be lifted by its open front edge.
        parts[f"module_{i+1}"] = tray
    return parts

item.text:
## Projeto concluído

Escolhi uma base com borda perimetral e três bandejas abertas iguais. Elas ficam apoiadas por gravidade, podem ser levantadas e reconfiguradas à mão, e têm uma abertura frontal para facilitar o acesso aos objetos.

Cada bandeja mede **169,3 × 35,3 × 28 mm**; a área interna estimada é **165,7 × 31,7 mm**, com aproximadamente **26 mm de profundidade**. Essas dimensões descrevem o espaço disponível, não uma compatibilidade confirmada: as ferramentas e suas quantidades não foram medidas. O relatório registra como resolver essa incerteza antes da versão final.

A comparação das alternativas, as limitações e os próximos passos estão em [RELATORIO.md](/tmp/cad3d-v141-eval/baseline/A-organizer/build/RELATORIO.md) e [design-rationale.md](/tmp/cad3d-v141-eval/baseline/A-organizer/design-rationale.md).

## Validação e arquivos

A validação CAD passou em validade geométrica, montagem, colisões e percurso amostrado de retirada. As exportações STEP reabriram e as malhas STL são válidas. O fatiamento estimado passou para a base e para uma bandeja representativa, usando o perfil Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 Combo com PETG: cerca de **7 h 05 min e 173 g** para o conjunto. Esse perfil é uma hipótese; a impressora real não foi especificada. A fabricação recebeu **WARNING** e a validação física segue pendente.
